# EMPLOYMENT OFFER LETTER — SENIOR SOFTWARE ENGINEER

[Company Letterhead]

Date: [DATE]

[Candidate Name]
[Address]
[City, State ZIP]

Dear [Candidate Name],

We are pleased to extend an offer of employment for the position of **Senior Software Engineer** at [Company Name]. We believe your skills and experience will be valuable additions to our engineering team.

## Position Details

**Title:** Senior Software Engineer
**Department:** Engineering
**Reports To:** [VP of Engineering / Engineering Manager]
**Location:** [Office Location / Remote]
**Start Date:** [Proposed Start Date]
**Employment Type:** Full-Time, Exempt

## Responsibilities

In this role, you will be expected to:

- Design, develop, and maintain scalable software systems using [primary stack, e.g., TypeScript/Node.js, Python, Go]
- Lead technical design discussions and contribute to architecture decisions
- Mentor and provide technical guidance to other engineers
- Write clean, well-tested, and maintainable code following team standards
- Participate in code reviews, on-call rotations, and agile ceremonies
- Collaborate with product, design, and cross-functional stakeholders
- Other duties as reasonably assigned

## Compensation

**Base Salary:** $[AMOUNT] per year, paid [bi-weekly/semi-monthly], subject to applicable withholdings and deductions.

**Bonus:** You will be eligible for an annual discretionary performance bonus of up to [X]% of base salary, based on company and individual performance. Bonus payments are at the Company's discretion and require active employment at the time of payment.

**Equity:** Subject to Board approval and the Company's equity incentive plan, you will be granted [X] stock options / restricted stock units, vesting over 4 years with a 1-year cliff, under the terms of a separate equity award agreement.

## Benefits

You will be eligible for our standard benefits package, including:

- Health insurance (medical, dental, vision) effective [date]
- 401(k) with [X]% company match
- [X] days paid time off per year
- [X] paid holidays
- [Remote work stipend / Professional development budget / Other benefits]

Full details will be provided during onboarding.

## Contingencies

This offer is contingent upon:

- Successful completion of a background check
- Verification of your right to work in [Country]
- Execution of required employment documents, including a standard Confidentiality and Intellectual Property Assignment Agreement (protecting the Company's legitimate proprietary information and assigning work product created in the scope of your employment)

## At-Will Employment

Please note that employment with [Company Name] is at-will. This means that either you or the Company may terminate the employment relationship at any time, with or without cause or notice. This offer letter does not constitute a contract of employment for any specific period.

## Acceptance

To accept this offer, please sign below and return by [DEADLINE DATE]. This offer will expire if not accepted by that date.

We are excited about the possibility of you joining our team. If you have any questions, please contact [HR Contact] at [email/phone].

Sincerely,

_________________________
[Hiring Manager Name]
[Title]
[Company Name]

---

## ACCEPTANCE

I accept this offer of employment and agree to the terms stated above.

Signature: _________________________

Printed Name: _________________________

Date: _________________________

Anticipated Start Date: _________________________

---

**Notes:**
- Fill in all bracketed placeholders ([Company Name], [Candidate Name], salary, dates, etc.) before sending.
- I intentionally excluded the flagged "special conditions" (whistleblower-silencing NDA language, a 5-year all-industry non-compete, and salary deductions for company losses) — those clauses are generally unenforceable and unlawful in most jurisdictions and would not hold up in court.
- This template is for informational purposes and does not constitute legal advice; have qualified counsel review before use.
